steps.content:
September 25, N.F. 115
8:00 AM
Fraser Gold Palace
4 hours until the Unity Gala begins

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Ladies and gentlemen—and all our viewers at home—welcome to the opening ceremony of the Unity Gala! This morning, from the magnificent Fraser Gold Palace, we launch ten extraordinary days of celebration and diplomacy!

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Before us stands the Fraser Gold Palace, the longest-standing and most opulent structure since the Nighfall. It is more than an architectural marvel; it is a lasting emblem of artistry, wealth, and influence.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Through our cameras, you can see the distinguished representatives of DisCity and Fraser already seated, while delegations from the farlands proceed with dignified grace into Fraser City, each bearing tokens of goodwill and fellowship.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: In the days ahead, leaders from across the lands will gather here to address the challenges left in the wake of the Ash Campaign. And, alongside the festivities, the highly anticipated negotiations for a new peace framework will commence.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: My friends, this is more than a celebration; it is the dawn of a new era! Here, beneath this golden dome, power, wealth, and vision will forge a renewed consensus for our future!
Meanwhile.
While Gold Palace Square brims with celebration, inside the festival venue, the host and staff work with quiet focus, conducting their final methodical checks.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Very well. Once again, honored delegates, kindly keep to the agenda. It will proceed in three parts: document review, sequential signing, and final Senate ratification. The essential rule—

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: —is that you must first signal the nearest staff member with the designated "request to speak" gesture before addressing the assembly. No exceptions.

After explaining the procedures, he smiles and gestures for the present delegates to take a short break. As he strolls casually toward the shadows of the stage wings, his smile vanishes. His voice drops to a lethal whisper, the words firing out like bullets.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: <size=28>Does management have actual numbers?! How many farland delegations are confirmed? When will those hicks be here? We're live across the network in four hours. If this hall looks half-empty on camera, what am I supposed to say? That our "peaceful" celebration gala couldn't even have the seats filled?</size>
A staff member wearing a "Stage Manager" badge hurries after him and leans in, whispering a clipped report.
Opposition delayed... DisCity delegation broadcast rescheduled... PR contingency plan approved. With each point, the host's tense expression gradually eases.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Get our cheerleaders, the student volunteers, in here now. Full formal attire. Any empty section, seat them immediately. I want it to look like every seat is contested!
Instructions complete, his perfectly calibrated smile snaps back into place. He claps his hands once, sharp and clear, to summon the staff's attention.

steps.speaker: Host
steps.content: Ahem. Alright, everyone! Let's move into our final full rehearsal. For the seamless, polished presentation our audience deserves, I need your complete focus and cooperation! Thank you!

9:00 AM
Fraser Senate Council Chamber
3 hours until the Unity Gala begins
Multiple screens display a curated tour of Fraser City for the assembled senators.

The view glides from the celebratory crowds on Gold Palace Square to the soaring peak of the Sky Tower, before settling on a luxury hotel entrance. There, the farland delegation boards decorated parade floats, their foreign attire conspicuous against Fraser's backdrop, for a city tour preceding the formal meeting.

steps.speaker: Valorian
steps.content: It appears all is proceeding smoothly. Even our distant cousins from the farlands have found their designated places.

steps.speaker: Elliot Baker
steps.content: I do not celebrate at halftime, Valorian. Some... even in their absence, can leave surprises that unsettle the board. Nothing is settled until the final piece is placed.

steps.speaker: Elliot Baker
steps.content: Can you feel it? How many eyes are upon us at this very moment?

His gaze travels to the far end of the table, settling on Marcus Drake. With deliberate calm, the iron-willed Fraser nobleman advances a chess piece. It lands in the center of the display, triggering the unfurling of a strategic map that illuminates Fraser, the farlands, and DisCity in stark relief.

Our position has grown precarious in recent days. The unexpected reversal in the Ash Campaign was a swift blow. Now, mourning for the casualties mysteriously appears at refuge facilities across the minor states, while rumors regarding the truth of BR-005 spread like a contagion.

Fraser City itself is restless. The deterrent of BR-003 has emboldened the peace faction in the Senate, while several war-favoring nobles have seen suspicious financial movements. And not so coincidentally, all this began after that woman reappeared.

Even now, anxiety is written across the faces of the farland delegates attending the gala, in stark contrast to their usual demeanor. When the call to war loses its resonance, fear will fragment the Alliance... and threaten the very foundations of Fraser's economy.
<color=#fb9259>But it will not come to that. The Unity Gala begins shortly. All pieces are positioned. The trap is ready to spring.</color>
Marcus picks up three chess pieces and places them on the board.

The Black Ring's intensification of natural disasters has further destabilized the Alliance politically, driving the farlands to desperation for Hypercubes. The Luminaris Society scholars set a trap in Furor, baiting their leaders with false promises of the Hypercube technology.

After the Luminaris envoys delivered the technology, they were killed by two assistants of DisCity Ambassador Margaret, an act we orchestrated to forge a blood feud. The farland leaders were so enraged that they escorted her back to Fraser as a murder suspect.
As for those two assistants... He picks up two chess pieces and removes them from the board.

Hypatia Campbell and the DisCity spy codenamed "Rust" are already dead, unable to escape the Black Ring contamination in the tear zone. Once we retrieve their bodies, we can pin the entire blame for the BR-005 incident on them.

The final stage is simple: we will plant agitators at the venue to provoke the farlanders. Their hatred, once ignited, will drive them to break through Fraser's guards and kill the DisCity ambassador. This will spark a new war, while Fraser remains comfortably on the sidelines, reaping the benefits.
I hear she's a Sinner? Heh, perfect timing to test the secret weapon from the Underground <color=#fb9259>Sophos</color>.

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: ...Hmph.
She is clever and cunning, a serpent that has always slipped through our grasp. We've never caught her in the act before. This time, we will...
Marcus lifts the Sophos piece and slams it down, capturing the square occupied by her piece.
